authority.boundary: Possession of the private signing key, held OFF-HOST and never present on the research host, together with protection of the allowed_signers file. The decided_by identity string is NOT the boundary: it selects which public key must have signed.

launch.EXECUTABLE_COMMAND_WARNING: This argv RUNS the experiment. It carries --execute and is NOT a dry run. Preparation and execution are distinguished by --apply on the wrapper invocation in operator_commands, never by editing this argv. An earlier version of this package told the operator to run this command without --apply, which would have executed the experiment.
launch.executable_command: sudo -n systemd-run --pipe --wait --collect --slice=wmresearch.slice -p User=apexresearch -p Group=apexresearch -p MemoryMax=1400M -p TasksMax=64 -p ProtectSystem=strict -p ProtectHome=yes -p PrivateTmp=yes -p PrivateNetwork=yes -p NoNewPrivileges=yes -p RestrictSUIDSGID=yes -p TemporaryFileSystem=/apex-data/history-b -p BindReadOnlyPaths=/apex-data/research/dataset_view/etf_continuous/bars:/apex-data/history-b/etf_continuous/bars -p InaccessiblePaths=/apex-data/core -p InaccessiblePaths=/apex-data/history-a -p InaccessiblePaths=/apex-data/runtime -p ReadOnlyPaths=/apex-data/governance/admissions -p ReadOnlyPaths=/etc/apex/admissions -p ReadWritePaths=/apex-data/research/out --setenv=GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null --setenv=GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 --setenv=PYTHONPATH=/apex-data/research/checkout --working-directory=/apex-data/research/checkout /opt/apex-runner/venv/bin/python scripts/alpha_exp_real_execute.py --decision /etc/apex/admissions/exp001b_admission.json --execute

operator_commands.execute_effect: runs the registered experiment inside the sandbox
operator_commands.prepare_effect: resolves and checks inputs, prints the plan, and launches NOTHING

preparation_checks_performed_elsewhere.dataset_content_integrity: NOT done by preparation, which counts files only. Done by the wrapper's `verify` action, whose dataset_inventory check re-hashes every admitted file and refuses on VIEW_HASH_MISMATCH. Run `verify` immediately before launching.
preparation_checks_performed_elsewhere.signature_verification: NOT done by preparation. Done by apex.world_model.real_data.boundary.verify_decision, called from scripts/alpha_exp_real_execute.py at execution time, which runs ssh-keygen -Y verify against /etc/apex/admissions/trust/allowed_signers. The operator can establish it in advance with the same ssh-keygen -Y verify command shown in the signing document.

purpose: Everything needed to review and sign the bounded EXP-001B train/validation admission. Generated by the wrapper, not transcribed by hand.

repin.second_repin_note: the second re-pin carries a wrapper that DOES change behaviour (trust-root containment, operator commands, check reporting). That is the point of it. The bound experiment tree is unchanged, so what the experiment computes is untouched.

scope.note: The admitted window is exactly train plus validation. The registration fixes economics to the evaluation stage only, so an economic number from this run would itself be a contract violation.
